# Rules

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:rules`. Do not edit by hand. -->

VibeGuard v1 has exactly three rule families. Every finding links to its rule page.

| Rule                                                                                | Default severity | What it finds                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`secrets/provider-key`](secrets/provider-key.md)                                   | critical         | Hardcoded provider credential                                  |
| [`secrets/provider-key-test`](secrets/provider-key-test.md)                         | low              | Hardcoded test-mode API key                                    |
| [`secrets/private-key`](secrets/private-key.md)                                     | critical         | Private key committed to the repository                        |
| [`secrets/high-entropy`](secrets/high-entropy.md)                                   | high             | Hardcoded secret, token or password                            |
| [`secrets/env-file-committed`](secrets/env-file-committed.md)                       | high             | Environment file with values is committed (or not gitignored)  |
| [`secrets/client-exposed-env`](secrets/client-exposed-env.md)                       | critical         | Secret exposed to the browser through a public env variable    |
| [`supabase/rls-disabled`](supabase/rls-disabled.md)                                 | critical         | Row Level Security is not enabled on an exposed table          |
| [`supabase/rls-no-policies`](supabase/rls-no-policies.md)                           | low              | Row Level Security enabled but no policies                     |
| [`supabase/permissive-policy`](supabase/permissive-policy.md)                       | high             | Overly permissive Row Level Security policy                    |
| [`supabase/service-role-in-client`](supabase/service-role-in-client.md)             | critical         | Supabase service_role key used in client-side code             |
| [`supabase/security-definer-view`](supabase/security-definer-view.md)               | medium           | View bypasses Row Level Security                               |
| [`supabase/security-definer-function`](supabase/security-definer-function.md)       | medium           | SECURITY DEFINER function callable through the API             |
| [`endpoints/unauthenticated-data-access`](endpoints/unauthenticated-data-access.md) | high             | Endpoint reads or changes data without an authentication check |
| [`endpoints/cors-wildcard-credentials`](endpoints/cors-wildcard-credentials.md)     | high             | CORS allows any origin together with credentials               |
| [`endpoints/auth-route-no-rate-limit`](endpoints/auth-route-no-rate-limit.md)       | medium           | Login / signup / reset endpoint without rate limiting          |
| [`endpoints/webhook-without-signature`](endpoints/webhook-without-signature.md)     | high             | Webhook endpoint does not verify the sender                    |
